description: This file defines the 'Card' data structure and related methods for handling content blocks within a project, including validation, conversion, and patching functionalities.

classes.name: ErrInvalidCard
classes.description: Error type for invalid card validation errors.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: Represents a content block with properties such as ID, BoardID, Title, ContentOrder, Icon, Properties, timestamps, and deletion status.

classes.name: CardPatch
classes.description: Structure for partial updates to a Card, including optional fields for Title, ContentOrder, Icon, and Properties.

methods.name: NewErrInvalidCard
methods.description: Creates a new ErrInvalidCard with a specified message.

methods.name: Error (ErrInvalidCard)
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for ErrInvalidCard.

methods.name: Error (ErrInvalidFieldType)
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for ErrInvalidFieldType.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates a Card with default ID, ContentOrder, Properties, and timestamps.

methods.name: PopulateWithBoardID
methods.description: Sets the BoardID of the Card and populates default values.

methods.name: CheckValid
methods.description: Validates the Card's fields, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a CardPatch to a Card, updating its fields.

methods.name: CheckValid (CardPatch)
methods.description: Validates the CardPatch, particularly the icon's grapheme count.

methods.name: Card2Block
methods.description: Converts a Card to a Block (shallow copy).

methods.name: Block2Card
methods.description: Converts a Block to a Card, extracting relevant fields.

methods.name: CardPatch2BlockPatch
methods.description: Converts a CardPatch to a BlockPatch for updates.
